subject.title: Fork-per-issue from one warmed repo box

question: Should Clownfish add a warmed per-repository workspace lease abstraction, and should the first implementation remain provider-neutral or commit to mitos/crabbox?
rationale: The capability is absent and would change the execution backend, trust boundary, lifecycle, and operator model, so maintainers must choose the durable platform contract before implementation.

options.title: Specify neutral lease
options.body: Define the workspace lifecycle, isolation guarantees, fallback behavior, and benchmark contract before implementing a backend.

options.title: Adopt mitos directly
options.body: Integrate mitos as the initial warmed-pool provider and accept direct operational coupling.

options.title: Defer the change
options.body: Retain independent hosted-runner clones and caches until measurements show setup dominates total worker cost.

recommendation.title: Specify neutral lease
recommendation.body: Define the workspace lifecycle, isolation guarantees, fallback behavior, and benchmark contract before implementing a backend.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the current checkout, toolchain, runner fan-out, and adjacent scaling paths most affected by the decision.
